messages.author: c73bd0fa408650b6
messages.subject: Change legend name and labels
parts:
Dear All,

Just starting on ggplot. It's great.

However using the code below (sorry I can not send data), I have not
managed to find how to change the name of the legend (which is
"(as.factor(variable)") or the labels of the variable
(which are "percon", "surcon","supcon")

I am very much confused on which "scale__xxx" I should use and in
addition each time I try my luck I get a error message saying breaks
should be specified. I don't know how to do that when I am refering
to levels of factor(variable).

Thanks for any help,

Best wishes, JL

#############script

emgcon <- melt(emg, id=c("patnb","studyday"), measure.vars=c("percon",
"surcon","supcon"))
#
p <- ggplot(emgcon, aes(studyday, value, group = variable,
colour=as.factor(variable), shape=as.factor(variable))) +
geom_line(size=1.2) + geom_point(size=3) +
xlab("Study Day") + ylab("Nerve Conduction (m/s)")+
facet_wrap( ~ patnb , ncol=2, scales = "free_y" ) + opts(title =
"Plot by Patient")

messages.author: c73bd0fa408650b6
messages.subject: RE: Change legend name and labels
parts:
Thanks Fernando.

I've made some progress as shown in the reproducible example below.

I am not sure (I doubt in fact ) I have the "optimal" code but it works
EXCEPT for one thing: the linetype is not in the legend together with
shape and color despite the scale_linetype_discrete().

Can anyone suggest how to get also the linetype in the legend ?

Thanks, JL

##### script ###########
#generate data
patnb <- rep.int(1:5,4)
studyday <- rep.int(1:4,5)
peramp <- rnorm(20, mean = 3, sd = 2)
suramp <- rnorm(20, mean = 5, sd = 2)
supamp <- rnorm(20, mean = 3, sd = 2)
emgs <- as.data.frame(cbind(patnb, studyday, peramp, suramp, supamp))
emgs <- emgs[order(emgs$patnb,emgs$studyday),]
#melt
emgamp2 <- melt(emgs, id=c("patnb","studyday"), measure.vars=c("peramp",
"suramp","supamp"))
#plot
p <- ggplot(emgamp2, aes(studyday, value, group = variable,
colour=as.factor(variable), shape=as.factor(variable))) +
geom_line(aes(linetype=as.factor(variable)),size=1.2) +
geom_point(size=3) +
xlab("Study Day") + ylab("CMAP amplitude (mvolt)") +

scale_shape(name = "Parameter",breaks=c("peramp",
"suramp","supamp"),labels=c("test 1", "test 2"," test 3")) +
scale_colour_discrete(name = "Parameter", breaks=c("peramp",
"suramp","supamp"),labels=c("test 1", "test 2"," test 3")) +
scale_linetype_discrete(name = "Parameter",
breaks=c("peramp", "suramp","supamp"),labels=c("test 1",
"test 2"," test 3")) +
opts(title = "Plot by Patient", legend.position =
c(0.8,0.2))
print(p)
######################

messages.author: d588a03e58ea7e7f
messages.subject: Re: Change legend name and labels
parts:
On Feb 15, 8:17 am, "Jean-Louis Abitbol" <jl.abit...@gmail.com> wrote:
>
> Can anyone suggest how to get also the linetype in the legend ?

The linetype is in the legend. Look at the "test 3" legend entry and
you can see that the dashing of the line causes it to not be shown to
the right of the point. The problem you are having is that with the
enlarged size of the point and line, the point is obscuring the breaks
in the line within the size of the box for the legend symbols. You
can make the box bigger by adding to your opts() call:

legend.key.size = unit(2.5, "lines")

Bumping it up to 3 lines makes it even more clear, but then it doesn't
fit within the space of the blank facet.

> Thanks, JL

--Brian Diggs
